title: Lab 221: Linux Package Management
description: The objective of this lab is to develop practical skills in Linux package management using YUM, including identifying the package manager, listing installed packages, searching repositories, inspecting package information, determining package installation status, identifying which package provides a command, installing packages, and removing packages.

lab_objective.description: The objective of this lab is to develop practical skills in managing software packages on a Linux system using YUM.
objectives: Understand the role of a Linux package manager.
Display and inspect currently installed packages.
Search configured repositories for available packages.
Determine whether a specific package is installed.
Identify which package provides a command or file.
Remove software packages safely using YUM.
Verify that a package has been removed.
Understand the basic workflow of package installation and removal.
Practice saving package-management command output for verification.
scenario:
You are working as a Linux system administrator responsible for maintaining software packages on a production server.

Your responsibilities include identifying the available package manager, reviewing installed software, searching configured repositories, inspecting package information, determining whether software is installed, identifying which package provides a required command, installing software when required, and safely removing software that is no longer needed.

You must follow the package-management procedures carefully and document the results of each task in the specified verification files.

tasks.title: Identify the Package Manager
steps: Before starting the lab, execute: yum remove httpd -y
Create a lab221_pkg_mgt directory inside your home directory.
Determine which package manager is available on the system.
Save the output of the command showing the installed YUM version to /home/your-user-name/lab221_pkg_mgt/package_manager.txt

tasks.title: Display Installed Packages
steps: Display the list of packages currently installed on the system.
Review the package name, architecture, and installed version information.

tasks.title: Search for a Package
steps: Search the configured repositories for packages related to httpd.
Review the search results and identify packages related to the Apache HTTP Server.

steps: Use YUM to determine whether the httpd package is currently installed.

steps: Determine which package provides the curl command.

tasks.title: Install a Package

After installation, verify that the httpd package is installed.

steps: Remove the httpd package that you installed in the previous task.

completion_message: Congratulations! You have completed Lab 221 - Linux Package Management. You identified the installed package manager and YUM version, reviewed installed packages, searched repositories, inspected package information, determined package installation status, identified which package provides a command, installed and verified a package, and safely removed the package using standard Linux package-management commands.
